items.title: File Einspruch against interest assessment
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest erheben. Die Frist beginnt mit der Bekanntgabe, die bei Versand durch die Post am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post eintritt.
items.computation: Letter dated (Aufgabe zur Post) Thursday 2026-11-19. Bekanntgabe fiction per letter's cited rule (current §122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO, 4-day rule): day 4 after posting = 2026-11-23 (Mon 23 Nov 2026; not a Sat/Sun/holiday in NRW, so no shift). One-month Einspruch period runs under §108 Abs.1 AO i.V.m. §§187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: since Bekanntgabe (23 Nov) is the triggering event, the period starts the next day and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the triggering day, i.e. 2026-12-23. 2026-12-23 is a Wednesday, not a Saturday/Sunday/public holiday in NRW, so no extension under §108 Abs.3 AO applies.

warnings: The refund-interest payment of 42,00 € is stated to be transferred together with the underlying tax refund, but no specific transfer date is given in the letter, so no payment item with a due date could be created for it.

The letter's stated 'vierten Tag' (4th day) Bekanntgabe fiction matches the current version of §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO (amended for the 2025 postal-delivery-time reform); double-check this is still in force if you rely on this deadline.
